title: Group-mean bars with correct NA handling, level order and no empty axis slot
source_relation: adapted: function-style contract, NA-only group and factor-level traps added, plot inspected through ggplot_build
difficulty_hypothesis: Agents use geom_bar() with the default count statistic, compute means without na.rm, ignore factor-level order, or pass raw rows to stat_summary so a group with no usable value keeps an empty slot (the discrete axis is trained before NA rows are removed).

mcp_relevance.rationale: Stat/geom semantics and scale training are core ggplot2 knowledge available from local help; the answer does not depend on a version or an external fact.
mcp_relevance.information_need: Difference between stat_count and stat_summary; when discrete scales are trained relative to NA removal.
alternative_solution_paths: filter rows then stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = 'bar')

calibration_risks.ceiling: high: the common patterns are well known; the empty-slot trap is the discriminator
blockers: ceiling effect likely for strong baselines: calibration must confirm

pinned_evidence.oracle: plain-R group means; plot inspected through ggplot_build (bar layer data, discrete scale range, labels)
